notes:
Account background:
- Large regional insurer; 1.2k employees, heavy peak-period claims volume (month-end spikes).
- Evaluating Redwood Dedicated for latency-sensitive claims-routing and document extraction POC; long-term target is Dedicated + Private for regulatory workloads.
- Initial procurement triggered by internal directive to replace in-house GPU endpoints (cost + ops pain).

Timeline / activities (recent):
- 2026-02-12: Intro call (Jordan + Priya) — scoping, high level architecture.
- 2026-02-18: Deep-dive (fireflies ff_2026-02-18_8342) with infra, security, and legal. Covered compliance, KMS, and residency.
- 2026-02-25: Pricing review; Redwood draft v3 shared (drive deck).
- 2026-03-04: SLA / Sizing workshop (ff_2026-03-04_1298). Discussed throughput guarantees + reserved GPU counts.
- 2026-03-09: SE follow-up — submitted list of required SLA clauses to legal (see drive contract).

Key technical requirements / POC targets:
- Workloads: claims-triage chat, attachments OCR + extraction, real-time reranking for search.
- Latency SLOs: 95th pctile token latency target ~ <150ms for short chat flows; end-to-end response for OCR+parse < 800ms for 90% (goal).
- Throughput: sustained 45 reqs/sec during peak (concurrent sessions ~600), burst tolerance to 150 reqs/sec for 5-15 min windows.
- Reserved GPU planning: initial commit request for 6 x H100-equivalent (or 8 x A100) for Dedicated pool; plan autoscale headroom of +50% during month-end.

SLA negotiation points (explicit asks from Strata legal/ops):
- Uptime target: prefer 99.99% for Dedicated control plane + model serving; Redwood baseline proposal currently 99.95%.
- Credits schedule: tiered credits tied to monthly uptime percentage; Strata requires pro-rata credits applied to committed monthly fee, with an annual cap at 12.5% as a floor — negotiating.
- P1/P2 response times: P1 (production outage affecting >10% of traffic) response <= 15 minutes, P1 resolution targets: initial MTR acknowledgement 2 hours, workaround 4 hours, full fix SLA to be negotiated. P2 (degraded service): response <= 1 hour.
- Maintenance windows: no more than 4 planned maintenance events per quarter affecting serving; require 14 days advance notice for planned maintenance that impacts Dedicated pool. Emergency maintenance allowed but must notify within 60 minutes and provide mitigation plan.
- Force majeure / region failover: automatic cross-region failover with routing policy; require documented RTO/RPO for backup region.
- Data residency & backups: backups for EU customers must stay in EU; Strata demands written certification of region residency for snapshot/backup copies.
- Termination & migration assistance: 180 days of export support plus managed migration runbook if Redwood fails SLA Q over two consecutive quarters.

Commercial asks / pricing notes:
- Requesting pricing for 6x H100 equivalent reserved with 12-month commit + optional burst pool.
- Credit calculation example requested: "If monthly uptime = 99.70% then credit = X% of monthly committed fee"; asked Redwood legal to provide explicit formula.
- Want optional 2-week free parallel run during onboarding to validate capacity planning (no credit charged if throughput misses target).

POC milestones / acceptance criteria:
- Week 0-2: integration + SSO test (SAML), data ingestion sample (10k docs).
- Week 3-4: performance test — sustain 45 reqs/sec for 1 hour with 95p latency <150ms.
- Week 5: security review closure (SOC2 evidence + KMS integration).
- Acceptance: sign-off from infra lead and CISO on residency & audit logging.

Open questions / client comments (paraphrased):
- "We need a clear SLA credit formula — percentage bands and how they apply to reserved vs overage billing."
- Concern: maintenance windows during end-of-month processing. Want blackout windows (two 6-hour windows) where maintenance is prohibited.
- Asking if Redwood can expose per-route latency SLOs and per-token cost reporting for audit.

Next steps (short):
- Jordan to circulate Redwood's explicit SLA draft (clauses: uptime calc, credit formula, maintenance notice) by 2026-03-12.
- Priya to produce GPU sizing options (H100 vs A100 cost delta) and cost delta for +50% burst headroom.
- Legal (Strata) to provide redlines to SLA by 2026-03-20.
- Schedule final exec review w/ procurement week of 2026-03-17.

Stubs / refs: pricing deck + SLA draft in Drive; security Q attached. Jira tickets INF-1248 (capacity test), SEC-3421 (KMS integration).
